## 🚀 Feature Proposal
A clear and concise description of the feature you're proposing.

## 💡 Motivation / Use Case
Why is this feature needed? What problem does it solve? (e.g. I'm always frustrated when [...])

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered, and how this feature would work in practice.

## 🎨 UI/UX Mockups (Optional)
If applicable, attach sketches or mockups of how this would look in the app.

## 📝 Additional Context
Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.
